Consolidate all polymorph JSON files into a single dataset

Train XGBoost model with specified hyperparameters (n_estimators=200, max_depth=8, learning_rate=0.1, etc.)

Model achieves test R²=0.62 and cross-validation R² mean=0.73±0.11, showing reasonable generalization; band gap is the most important feature
